en.hubeali: H 14758 – Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Ayyub, from Abdul Momin Al-Ansary, who has narrated: Abu Ja’farasws having said that:

‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> has Granted three characteristics to the Believer – the honour in the world and the Hereafter, and the success in the world and the Hereafter, and the prestige in front of the unjust ones’.
en.sarwar: 310. Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Ayyub, from Abdul Momin Al-Ansary, who has narrated: Abu Ja’far (a.s.) having said that:

‘Allah (azwj) has Granted three characteristics to the Believer – the honour in the world and the Hereafter, and the success in the world and the Hereafter, and the prestige in front of the unjust ones’.
